name: claude-watermark-remover
description: Rewrite ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini text so its statistical watermark no longer matches, with your own OpenRouter key. Free models included.
long_description: One rewrite by one model that is instructed to keep the meaning, structure, formatting and language of your text; links, quotations, amounts and percentages return unchanged. Your text goes only to OpenRouter with your own key. Measured on SynthID Text with a research key; the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini detectors are not public, so complete removal cannot be verified. Hosted version without keys, for claude.ai on the web and phones: https://painintheagent.com

tools.name: remove_watermark
tools.description: Rewrite the wording of a text and report the share of five-word sequences replaced; links, quotes, amounts and the layout stay.

tools.name: get_configuration
tools.description: Read the configured model and the measured presets.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Create one at https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys. A free OpenRouter account is enough. It is stored by Claude Desktop and never leaves your computer except to OpenRouter.

model.title: Model
model.description: OpenRouter free models, tried in this order; ids ending in :free, separated by commas. Free models are slow and are withdrawn without notice; see the README for what was measured.
